fields.col30: Nice symmetric burn, some soot at 10 cm/s, Steady spreading, flame seems to reach a steady length. Decreasing flow shrinks flame and changes to mostly blue, but still spreading. Gets very dim near end of sample as it shrinks and extinguishes at burnout. Don noted the fiberglass matrix was still intact after the burn.

fields.col30: Very bright sooty ball. Lots of vapor jetting. N2 on at 1 minute. Blew off stagnation region but N2 did not extinguish wake, even with air flow off. Don turned off air, then N2 after some seconds. Wake flame sooty and wind-blown. Only extinguishes when all flow stops. N2 is entraining air to flame zone. Don noted that there was no soot on the sphere, just the 'char layer'. ~ 2 minute total burn.
